Hi Elena — thanks for the packet and the heads up. I can start a PO audit but need procurement + finance to confirm two things before we issue a formal PO:

1) Verify SKU mapping to Redwood catalog (we occasionally re-map vendor SKUs to internal item codes).
2) Confirm whether the $45,000 spend hold is intended to cover ongoing usage (multi-month) or just the first cycle. If it's multi-month, we may need a different spend-scheduling approach.

Connor — can you take a look at the attached form and run a quick SKU reconciliation? Marissa, looping you for any spend-cap policy notes for partner onboarding.

Elena — if you can confirm the cadence and share any additional billing contact (for AP), we'll aim to issue a provisional PO within 24–48 hours pending the SKU fixes.

Thanks,

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Solaris onboarding — missing PO number and spend cap hold

Ava / Marissa — I pulled the onboarding form and ran it against our catalog. Found two issues that explain the issuance gap:

- Line 2 (Solaris SKU: SLR-XL-200) was submitted as a single consolidated line; our ledger requires it split into SLR-XL-200 (software license) and SLR-XL-200-SERV (installation services). That changes the line-item coding and affects GL mapping.
- Line 3 (Solaris SKU: SLR-ADDITIONAL) is flagged as a non-standard add-on that needs procurement approval for exception pricing; that triggers an extra approval step which likely caused the hold.

I've attached a quick audit CSV that shows proposed splits and the internal item codes: po_audit_20261202.csv

Proposal to unblock:
1) Approve the SKU split as per the attached (no price change, just coding).
2) Grant exception approval for SLR-ADDITIONAL up to $3,000 one-time; procurement to log exception in the tracker.

If you approve (Elena / Solaris), I can push the corrected line items to Finance so they can issue a provisional PO number and lift the hold.

Connor O'Brien
Procurement Operations — Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Solaris onboarding — missing PO number and spend cap hold

Team — reviewed Connor's audit and the spend profile. Finance is comfortable issuing a provisional PO to get Solaris set up while we complete the exception documentation.

Action:
- Provisional PO number: PO-2026-10987 (issued to hold funds and allow first invoice).
- Spend cap: set to $50,000 temporary ceiling (gives ~$7,250 buffer for initial adjustments).
- Condition: procurement must complete the SKU split record in ProcTracker and attach exception approval for SLR-ADDITIONAL within 5 business days.

Connor — please push the updated line-item file to ProcTracker and tag me. Marissa — flag any policy edge cases if the add-on becomes recurring.

I'll mark the accounting hold as cleared once ProcTracker shows the updated record.

Rishi Malhotra
